paragraphs.text: Lathliss , Dragon Queen , is a legendary dragon from an unknown plane .

Dragons embody the fury and ferocity of red , and those that rise to power among their kind exemplify that violent energy. Lathliss styles herself a queen among dragons and had earned that position by leading her kin in relentless raids in villages and cities built too near her expansive territory. It is said that she keeps the heart of the previous dragon queen sealed within a jewel.
